operation.description:
Lists suites of rule evaluations at the repository level.
For more information, see "[Managing rulesets for a repository](https://docs.github.com/repositories/configuring-branches-and-merges-in-your-repository/managing-rulesets/managing-rulesets-for-a-repository#viewing-insights-for-rulesets)."

#/components/parameters/actor-name-in-qu.description: The handle for the GitHub user account to filter on. When specified, only rule evaluations triggered by this actor will be returned.
#/components/parameters/actor-name-in-qu.name: actor_name

#/components/parameters/evaluate-status.description:
The evaluate status to filter on. When specified, only rule suites resulting from rulesets with the specified evaluate status will be returned.
  - `all` - all rule suites will be returned.
  - `active` - only rule suites resulting from rulesets in active (non-evaluate) mode will be returned.
  - `evaluate` - only rule suites resulting from rulesets in evaluate mode will be returned.
#/components/parameters/evaluate-status.name: evaluate_status

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
#/components/parameters/page.name: page

#/components/parameters/per-page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
#/components/parameters/per-page.name: per_page

#/components/parameters/ref-in-query.description: The name of the ref. Cannot contain wildcard characters. Optionally prefix with `refs/heads/` to limit to branches or `refs/tags/` to limit to tags. Omit the prefix to search across all refs. When specified, only rule evaluations triggered for this ref will be returned.
#/components/parameters/ref-in-query.name: ref

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/parameters/rule-suite-resul.description: The rule suite results to filter on. When specified, only suites with this result will be returned.
#/components/parameters/rule-suite-resul.name: rule_suite_result

#/components/parameters/time-period.description:
The time period to filter by.

For example, `day` will filter for rule suites that occurred in the past 24 hours, and `week` will filter for rule suites that occurred in the past 7 days (168 hours).
#/components/parameters/time-period.name: time_period

actor_id.description: The number that identifies the user.

actor_name.description: The handle for the GitHub user account.

after_sha.description: The last commit sha in the push evaluation.

before_sha.description: The first commit sha before the push evaluation.

evaluation_result.description: The result of the rule evaluations for rules with the `active` and `evaluate` enforcement statuses, demonstrating whether rules would pass or fail if all rules in the rule suite were `active`.

id.description: The unique identifier of the rule insight.

ref.description: The ref name that the evaluation ran on.

repository_id.description: The ID of the repository associated with the rule evaluation.

repository_name.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension.

result.description: The result of the rule evaluations for rules with the `active` enforcement status.
